items.evidence: mosaic_virus.json:/content_en/condition/scientific_name; /aliases; /condition/alt_names
items.finding: ToMV scientific name mixed with TMV aliases.
items.action: Keep TOM_MOSAIC stable; hold candidate mapping; verify ToMV scope from authoritative evidence before deriving separate corrected card.

items.evidence: early_blight.json:/content_en/aliases/1; target_spot.json:/content_en/condition/scientific_name
items.finding: Early blight alias 'target spot of tomato' overlaps a different Corynespora condition.
items.action: Block alias, preserve the two explicit identity mappings and raw records.

items.evidence: late_blight.json:/content_en/issue_type; /condition/pathogen/type; /condition/scientific_name
items.finding: Phytophthora infestans is an oomycete although source category/ID says fungal.
items.action: Use derived oomycete category only; retain disease_id_original.

items.evidence: late_blight.json:/content_en/management/biological/0; mosaic_virus.json:/content_en/management/cultural/1
items.finding: Copper hydroxide and 10% bleach occur outside chemical arrays.
items.action: Gate whole mixed claims by content, local applicability and approval; no silent splitting or dosage addition.

items.evidence: mosaic_virus.json:/content_en/management/chemical/1; /transmission/vectors
items.finding: Aphid insecticide advice is not established for the mechanically transmitted ToMV concept.
items.action: Hold claim; do not create aphid treatment from this class.

items.evidence: mosaic_virus.json:/content_en/management/biological/0
items.finding: Mild-virus cross-protection is commercial and outside home-care MVP.
items.action: Block release; request specialist interpretation, do not advise introducing virus.

items.evidence: spider_mites.json:/content_en/management/cultural/1; late_blight.json:/content_en/management/cultural/2
items.finding: Periodic overhead/misting is broader than small-garden mite washing and conflicts with dry-foliage disease control.
items.action: Hold whole claim pending context; no top-k regimen mixing.

items.evidence: healthy.json:/content_en/aliases; /vqa_templates; /severity
items.finding: Healthy leaf class cannot establish whole-plant no-disease status or severity.
items.action: Only scoped leaf state and basic care; no disease treatment.

items.evidence: all 17 cards:/review; /content_en/provenance; claim-ledger.json
items.finding: Generic provenance is not claim-level authority or project expert approval; all real cards remain pending and safe_for_advice=false.
items.action: Attach claim evidence; obtain accountable domain approval separately from translation review.

items.evidence: all cards:/review/translation; glossary-vi-draft.json; planning/tomato-desktop/architecture.md
items.finding: Disease names are drafts; complete translation cannot override domain review, and old approvals must not survive changed EN content.
items.action: Hash-bind EN claim/source and VI text; separate domain/translation actors and dates.

items.evidence: reference-links.json; confounder-links.json; leaf_curl_virus.json; yellow_leaf_curl_virus.json
items.finding: 24 of 47 lookalike references unresolved; leaf curl complex is not automatically TYLCV; herbicide_damage card absent.
items.action: No fuzzy/suffix acceptance; keep unresolved references pending and distinct card scopes.

items.evidence: PlantVillage label-mapping.json:class_order_policy; class-manifest.proposed.json
items.finding: No finalized class_to_idx or trained checkpoint exists.
items.action: Approve versioned ordered manifest before training; model loader must compare version/hash/order.

items.evidence: PlantVillage current summary.json; manifest.csv:leaf_group_id,flags,record_status
items.finding: 6749 source images lack evidenced grouping; Target Spot 1404 and mosaic 373 have no evidenced groups. Independent label review and full split remain pending.
items.action: Keep training_ready=false; resolve grouping/near duplicates before split, no cleaning rerun here.

items.evidence: scripts/data/review_integration.py:validate_bundle,lookup
items.finding: Duplicate IDs, absent cards, stale hashes or healthy-to-disease mapping can invalidate lookup.
items.action: Reject malformed bundle and return needs_check with empty guidance; verify with synthetic fixtures.

items.evidence: target_spot.json:/content_en/risk_factors; UF/IFAS PP351 leaf wetness discussion
items.finding: Card mentions 8-hour leaf wetness; extension describes 16–44 hours in studied conditions.
items.action: Do not generalize either as universal threshold; verify experimental context before advice.

items.evidence: cercospora_leaf_spot.json:/content_en/aliases; UConn Tomato Stemphylium
items.finding: Gray leaf spot name also refers to Stemphylium; name alone cannot establish Cercospora identity.
items.action: Hold this alias; knowledge-only card stays outside classifier.

items.evidence: raw/plantvillage/README_HF.md; raw/plantexpert/README.md; cultivation_metadata source metadata
items.finding: Local/aggregate license declarations do not establish rights and attribution for every constituent advice text or image.
items.action: Review component license chain and attribution before redistribution; CC-BY/CC-BY-SA obligations stay separate.

items.evidence: planning/tomato-desktop/README.md: historical next action; knowledge-localization-edtech.md; architecture.md
